transcript:
[00:00] Guys, let's be honest, picking stocks is fun.
[00:02] Finding the needle in the haystack, going out, doing research, trying to find that one
[00:08] stock, right?
[00:09] But if you don't want to do that, which the majority of people don't want to do that,
[00:14] you can go and buy ETFs that track certain sectors and do pretty well long term.
[00:21] I mean, you might not do as well as if, let's say, you went and bought a penny stock or
[00:27] the one stock that went up thousands of percent but picking ETFs you can do pretty well this is an
[00:33] energy ETF ticker symbol XLE this tracks a bunch of the biggest energy companies in the world this
[00:40] right here is a semiconductor ETF think of Nvidia AMD Micron right this has done very well 7.5% in
[00:50] the green year to date and this right here is a healthcare ETF ticker symbol XLV and the one before
[00:56] I forgot to mention was ticker symbol SMH. So you don't always have to find the needle in the
[01:02] haystack, guys. ETFs are great.
